title: Retiam Engine: Comprehensive Implementation & Architecture Guide

blocks.content: Engineering notebook from `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md`. This archive preserves the project’s original rationale, equations, performance reports and illustrative code. Historical paths, API names, claims and sketches can differ from the current engine. For copy-ready programs use the guides and demos; for current callable signatures use the source-derived API. Performance figures here describe reported experiments, not guaranteed frame rates.

blocks.text: Original document: [docs/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

This document provides an exhaustive, up-to-date reference of all major architectural subsystems, memory models, rendering pipelines, geometry allocators, and performance optimizations implemented in the **Retiam WebGPU Engine**.

Retiam is a high-performance, WebGPU-native 2D/3D graphics and mathematical animation engine designed for real-time rendering, complex mathematical visualization, and cinematic video export with **0.0 KB Minor GC (Zero Garbage Collection)** and **sub-millisecond CPU frame times**.

blocks.code:
flowchart TD
    subgraph SceneGraph [1. Scene Graph & State System]
        Scene[Scene / SceneComposer] --> RootEntity[Entity Hierarchy]
        RootEntity --> DirectSlots[Persistent State Slots in GlobalStateAllocator]
        DirectSlots --> VersionMemo[Hierarchical Version Memoization]
    end

    subgraph MemoryGPU [2. GPU Memory & Buffer Upload]
        VersionMemo --> CPUData[Contiguous cpuData Buffer]
        CPUData --> WriteBuffer[Single queue.writeBuffer Upload]
        WriteBuffer --> GlobalStorage["@group(2) Global State Buffer (EntityState[])"]
    end

    subgraph RenderPipeline [3. Render Pipeline & Execution]
        Scene --> RenderQueue[Render Queue Build]
        RenderQueue --> StateCache[RenderStateCache: Pipeline, Buffer & Scissor Caching]
        StateCache --> RenderPass[RenderPass / ShadowPass / OffscreenPass]
    end

    subgraph Shaders [4. Bindless WGSL Shader Execution]
        GlobalStorage --> VS["Vertex Shader: Read states[getStateIndex(instance_index)]"]
        VS --> FlatVaryings["Flat Varyings Forwarding (@interpolate(flat))"]
        FlatVaryings --> FS[Fragment Shader: Zero Storage Reads]
        FS --> Framebuffer[Target Framebuffer / Output]
    end

blocks.text: Implemented in commit `194d9c8a`, Retiam transitioned from dynamic uniform buffer offsets to a **global bindless storage architecture**.

items: **Single Pass-Level Binding:** `@group(2)` is bound **once per render pass** rather than per entity packet.

blocks.text: C. Flat Varying State Forwarding (Zero Fragment Storage Reads)
To prevent memory bandwidth bottlenecks on mobile and integrated GPUs, fragment shaders do not read the global storage buffer:

items: **Vertex Shader Fetch & Packing ([`Domains.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/shader_system/Domains.ts)):** The Vertex Shader reads `states[getStateIndex(instance_index)]` once and packs `Paint`, `State`, and `Material` properties into `@interpolate(flat)` varyings (`v_paint_fill`, `v_paint_stroke`, `v_paint_params`, `v_paint_clip`, `v_state_params`, `v_mat_color`, `v_mat_em`, `v_mat_pbr`, `v_mat_tex`).
**Fragment Shader Unpacking:** The Fragment Shader unpacks structs directly from vertex varyings, achieving **zero storage buffer memory reads** during the pixel shading phase.

blocks.text: D. AST-Free Clip Parameter Regex Transforms

[`ShaderBuilder.injectInstanceIndexIntoClipCalls()`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/shader_system/ShaderBuilder.ts) parses compiled shader sources and injects `instance_index` into single-argument `clip2D(p)`, `clip3D(p)`, and `clipSpace(p)` calls at shader build time.
Replaced vertex buffer bindings with `@group(3)` storage buffer resources and vertex pulling:

items: **`Instanced.ts`:** Pulls `iPosScale`, `iColor`, `iRot` from storage via `getLocalIndex(instance_index)`.
**`ModelGeometry.ts` & `MorphGeometry.ts`:** Splats and swarm particles pull positions and normals via `getLocalIndex(instance_index)`.
**`TextGeometry.ts`:** Text glyph vertices are stored in storage buffers and pulled programmatically.
**`PathGeometry.ts`:** Analytical curve contours pass `contourStartIndex` through `state.transform.pad2`.

blocks.text: Located in [`src/engine/render/allocator/GlobalStateAllocator.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/allocator/GlobalStateAllocator.ts), this allocator manages CPU/GPU state synchronization.

children: Each entity acquires a fixed slot index in `GlobalStateAllocator` during initialization.
`entity.worldState` directly overlays a 256-byte slice (64 floats) of `cpuData`.
When entities are destroyed, slots are recycled into `_freeSlots`.
Dynamically allocated temporary states (e.g. for sub-passes) receive pre-mapped contiguous slot instances without object allocations.
When capacity is exceeded, the allocator grows geometrically ($2\times$), preserves existing state data, and remaps active state views.
Replaces fragmented range tracking with a single contiguous `queue.writeBuffer(gpuBuffer, 0, cpuData, 0, maxSlots * BYTES_PER_STATE)` per frame.
`State.BYTELENGTH = 256` (64 floats) aligned to 16-byte GPU uniform/storage standards.

blocks.text: Retiam is architected to eliminate Garbage Collection and minimize CPU overhead:

cells.text: Tracks monotonic `localVersion` and `parentVersion` across `Transform`, `Paint`, and `Material`. Bypasses `worldState.apply()` when unmutated.
Eliminates 30,000 matrix multiplications on static nodes.
Bypasses `buildRenderQueues()`, `traverse()`, and state buffer uploads during camera-only interactions (orbit/pan/zoom).
Frame time drops to **< 0.05 ms (600+ FPS)**.
Tracks active updaters down the hierarchy. When `0`, `Entity.update()` early-outs in $O(1)$.
Skips 30,000 empty update hooks and closure allocations.
Tracks interactive descendants. Prunes non-pickable branches at root.
Reduces pointer move traversal from 30,000 nodes to 1 check.
Pre-allocates and caches retained `DrawCall[]` arrays across all geometry classes.
Eliminates 30,000 temporary array instantiations per frame.
[`RenderStateCache`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/RenderStateCache.ts) caches pipelines, vertex buffers, index buffers, and scissor rectangles.
Reduces WebGPU driver scissor calls from 30,000 to **1 per frame**.

blocks.text: Retiam features a dual-engine 2D vector geometry pipeline:

blocks.code:
graph LR
    SVGSource[SVG String / Path Data] --> Parser[SVG Parser & Path Normalizer]
    Parser --> Choice{Rendering Mode}
    Choice -- "fast / accurate / fill" --> Earcut[TriangulatedPathGeometry: CPU Earcut & Tessellation]
    Choice -- "analytical / stroke" --> GlobalPoints[GlobalAnalyticalAllocator: Bezier Curve Storage]
    Earcut --> GPUIndices[Global Index / Vertex Buffer]
    GlobalPoints --> ComputeShader[GPU Stencil & Path Stroke Pipelines]

items: **Modes:** Supports `method: "fast" | "accurate" | "fill" | "stroke" | "analytical"`.
**Configurable Tessellation:** Parameters for `tolerance` and `maxSegments` allow tuning between visual fidelity and vertex count.
**Extrusion & Fill:** Integrated CPU polygon triangulation (via Earcut) and polyline stroke extrusion for single-pass triangle list rendering.
**Overlap & Z-Fighting Resolution:** Dedicated vertex depth offsetting and overlap resolution for complex SVG artwork (e.g. Paris 30K).

blocks.text: B. Analytical Bezier Curve Engine (PathGeometry & GlobalAnalyticalAllocator)

items: **GPU Curve Representation:** Stores quadratic and cubic Bézier curves directly in global analytical GPU buffers (`gpuGlobalPoints`, `gpuGlobalIndices`).

children: `stencil_chain` & `stencil_quad`: Evaluates Bézier winding numbers into the stencil buffer.
`fill_cover`: Draws bounding geometry masked by the stencil buffer.
`path_stroke_hard` & `path_stroke_edge`: GPU-evaluated variable-width stroke rendering with anti-aliased edges.
`clear`: Clears stencil state for subsequent path rendering.

items: `CUSTOM_UNLIT`: General unlit 2D/3D geometry with user-defined vertex and fragment logic.
`COMMON_2D`: 2D paths, shapes, and sprite geometry.
`STENCIL_OPS`: Hardware stencil operations and vector path winding evaluation.
`PATH_STROKE`: GPU analytical Bézier curve stroking.
`MODEL3D`: Complete 3D mesh domain with PBR material parameters, lighting, and normal transformations.
Mathematical 3D implicit surface raymarching with analytical normals, soft shadows, ambient occlusion, and lighting.

**Module-Scoped WGSL State (`var<private> state: State;`):** Enables direct access to transform matrices, bounding parameters, and animation variables (`state.t1`, `state.t2`) inside nested math equations (`map(p)`, `calcNormal(p)`, `surfaceFunc(x, z)`).

**Flat Material Varying Unpacking:** Material properties (`v_mat_color`, `v_mat_em`, `v_mat_pbr`, `v_mat_tex`) are interpolated flat from the vertex shader and unpacked in registers, achieving **zero storage buffer reads** in fragment shaders.

blocks.text: C. Texturing & Filtered Texture Array Sampling

items: Full support for `texture_2d_array` textures for materials and font atlases.

[`sampleTexture4xGrad`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/shaders/includes/math.wgsl) uses `textureSampleGrad(..., dx, dy)` with screen-space UV derivatives to eliminate texture array sampling seams and derivative artifacts.

blocks.text: Retiam organizes GPU rendering into modular passes:

blocks.code:
graph TD
    ShadowPass[ShadowPass: Light-Space Depth Map Generation] --> MainRenderPass[RenderPass: Main Scene Rasterization]
    OffscreenPass[OffscreenRenderPass: Nested & Layer Textures] --> MainRenderPass
    MainRenderPass --> FeedbackTexture[PersistentRenderTexture: Feedback & Ping-Pong Loops]
    FeedbackTexture --> PostProcess[Post-Processing & SSAA]

items.text: **`RenderPass`:** Primary rasterization pass executing sorted `render_queue` commands with layer mask culling, viewport clipping, and aggregated shadow/texture bind groups.
children: **Dynamic `@group(3)` Bind Group Cache Invalidation:** Tracks `_instancedAlbedoTex`, `_instancedNormalTex`, and `_instancedExtraBuffer` on geometries to prevent stale/destroyed texture references when global texture arrays are re-allocated.

items: **`ShadowPass`:** Generates light-space depth maps for 3D model casting and self-shadowing.
**`OffscreenRenderPass` & `PersistentRenderTexture`:** Supports rendering layers to offscreen textures, persistent feedback buffers, and multi-camera viewport compositions.
**Anti-Aliasing & AI Denoising:** Multi-sample anti-aliasing (SSAA, Bilinear) and integration with Intel Open Image Denoise (`oidn-web`).
**Atomic & Composite Animators:** Transitions including `Create`, `FadeIn`, `FadeOut`, `Transform`, `MoveTo`, `ScaleTo`, `RotateBy`, and property tweens with customizable easing functions.
**Timeline Controller:** Playback speed, seeking, reverse playback, and time-scale controls.
**Hardware-Accelerated Video Recording:** In-browser MP4 and WebM video export via WebCodecs, `mp4-muxer`, and `webm-muxer` for deterministic 60 FPS frame capture and rendering.

**[Poly (Polygon & Polyline) Architecture & GPU Extrusion](/notes-poly-architecture-and-usage)**: Deep dive into GPU compute ribbon stroke extrusion, dual-mode stencil filling (non-zero & even-odd), analytical rounded corner mathematics, and raycasting.

**[Scene Graph Architecture, Hierarchy Traversal & State Synchronization](/notes-scene-graph-architecture)**: Deep dive into the Entity hierarchy, SceneComposer traversal, 256-byte aligned GPU state memory blocks, matrix propagation, and zero-GC render queue building.

**[GPU Compute & ComputeKernel Architecture](/notes-compute-and-compute-kernel-architecture)**: Deep dive into the declarative `ComputeKernel` API, low-level engine compute pipelines (`Compute.ts`), workgroup sizing, parallel prefix scan, and FrameGraph integration.

**[FrameGraph Architecture, Extensibility & Custom Pass Guide](/notes-frame-graph-architecture-and-extensibility)**: Deep dive into DAG compilation, Kahn's topological sort, dead-code culling, transient resource memory pooling, `@read`/`@write`/`@create` decorators, and writing custom `IPlugin` render features.

**[Analytical Path Architecture, SDF Geometry & Stencil Pipeline](/notes-analytical-path-architecture)**: Bit-by-bit breakdown of SVG quadratic decomposition, GlobalAnalyticalAllocator, GPU compute encoders, Cardano cubic root solvers, and Stencil-and-Cover Fill & SDF Stroke pipelines.

**[firstInstance Bit-Packing Architecture & Limits](/notes-first-instance-bit-packing-architecture)**: Exhaustive breakdown of `firstInstance` multiplexing, Dual-Mode bit allocation, Bit 30 pass discrimination, hardware instancing addition carries, and mathematical limits.

**[Instanced Architecture & Usage Guide](/notes-instanced-architecture-and-usage)**: Deep dive into programmable vertex-pulling hardware instancing, storage buffer layouts, and vector path instancing.

**[Instanced, Arrange & WebGPU Compute Architecture & Usage Guide](/notes-arrange-and-instanced-compute-architecture)**: Comprehensive guide covering Instanced, Arrange (CPU vs. GPU instancing modes), real-time WebGPU Compute Shader integration (`onCompute`), memory layout, and 65,536-instance demonstrations.
**[Fast Path & Adaptive LOD Architecture](/notes-fast-path-and-adaptive-lod)**: High-speed CPU triangulation, intermediate quadratic representations, and screen-space hysteresis LOD.
**[Bindless Varying State Architecture](/notes-bindless-varying-state-architecture)**: 32-bit state packing, draw call batching, and branchless WGSL decoders.

**[RenderTarget Architecture & Unified API Guide](/notes-render-target-architecture-and-api)**: Physics3D-style entity management, direct Sprite integration, pre-raster zero-latency scheduling, and camera/projection options for intermediate render targets.

**[TrackBuilder & TrackAnimation Architecture](/notes-track-builder-and-animation-architecture)**: Declarative entity-level animation lifecycle, fluent `TrackBuilder` timeline sequencing (.add parallel/series, .wait), proportional duration scaling, and seamless `Create` delegation.
**[Performance Optimizations](/notes-performance-optimizations)**: Zero-GC memory pools, render state caching, and batch dispatching.
